purpose_zh: 把企业获得的到岗、接驳和路缘服务，与居民必须保住的日常到达、无障碍、人工入口、失败分母和申诉暂停权放在同一张发布门上。
purpose_en: Put enterprise arrival, feeder and curb benefits on the same release gate as resident daily access, accessibility, human entry, failure denominators and the right of an appeal to pause release.

identity_boundary.this_package: reciprocal allocation and accountability between enterprise requests and resident/public-service guarantees
identity_boundary.mobility_commons_jingzhang: network and mode operations; referenced only and not modified by this package
identity_boundary.commute_co_benefit_jingzhang: demand, capacity and failure-policy operations; referenced only and not modified by this package

review_cases.enterprise_request_zh: 班车合并、员工到岗与访客落客窗口
review_cases.enterprise_request_en: merged shuttles, employee arrivals and visitor drop-off windows
review_cases.resident_return_zh: 上学、照护与无障碍站口路线不被企业优先级切断
review_cases.resident_return_en: school, care and accessible station routes remain continuous despite enterprise priority

review_cases.enterprise_request_zh: 装卸、充电与维修短时窗口
review_cases.enterprise_request_en: short loading, charging and maintenance windows
review_cases.resident_return_zh: 消防、轮椅、步行和社区服务通道保持连续
review_cases.resident_return_en: fire, wheelchair, walking and community-service passages remain continuous

review_cases.enterprise_request_zh: 夜班接驳、班次调整与数字调度
review_cases.enterprise_request_en: night-shift feeders, timetable changes and digital dispatch
review_cases.resident_return_zh: 断网或天气恶化时仍能靠公共交通、电话或人工回家
review_cases.resident_return_en: public transport, telephone or staffed return remains usable during outage or bad weather

review_cases.enterprise_request_zh: 服务恢复、设备复用与重新开放
review_cases.enterprise_request_en: service restoration, asset reuse and reopening
review_cases.resident_return_zh: 原记录不被覆盖，申诉可暂停发布，公共路线先恢复
review_cases.resident_return_en: prior records persist, appeals pause release and public routes recover first

claim_boundary.package_replay: may report structural PASS when the bundled fixture reproduces gates and rollback
claim_boundary.field_release: HOLD until dated local evidence, accepted responsibility, locked denominators, current accessibility evidence and authorization exist
